title: Act 1 loader: ordinary open and held-Space exit/entry roundtrip
input_audit: The real Act 1 Playtest constructor owns tank spawn and world content; no diagnostic-origin replacement is used. Initial station is the only scenario positioning. Timeline actions only turn the current head toward an authored aperture or handle. H or LMB opens the real hatch. All exit and entry transitions must originate from ordinary TankInput.jump (Space), with a release between the two long holds. Gaze returns to the aperture while Space is still held after each transition: neither hold may initiate a second traversal. No dismount, mount, station, on_foot, position, readiness, inventory or hatch-phase injection is allowed.
visual_acceptance: The authored Act 1 winter city and original tank spawn remain in use, with practice enemy fire disabled.
The complete loader lid opens on its original hinge; the player exits through that opening onto solid exterior tank geometry.
At 3.2 seconds the exterior gaze returns to the open aperture while Space is held, and the player stays outside until a new Space press.
The second Space press traverses the same aperture and finishes in the loader station. Looking at the opening while Space remains held must not eject the player again.
The camera never drops through sealed armor, teleports to a diagnostic origin, or leaves the player unsupported inside the tank mesh.
limitations: This fixture is input and assertion coverage until its runtime receipt passes and its first-person frames are reviewed. Geometry or reachability failures must remain failures; no automatic position correction may be added to the capture.
